Savska cesta 32

Datum donošenja i početka primjene: 02. rujna 2026.
1. PRIMJENA

Ovi Opći uvjeti poslovanja i Cjenik primjenjuju se na posredovanje MET d.o.o. pri dugoročnom najmu stanova na području Zagreba i zagrebačke metropole te čine sastavni dio svakog ugovora o posredovanju koji MET d.o.o. sklapa s nalogodavcem.
2. POSLOVI OBUHVAĆENI POSREDNIČKOM NAKNADOM
U uobičajenom opsegu otvorenog i isključivog posredovanja naknada obuhvaća:
upoznavanje Nalogodavca s prosječnom tržišnom najamninom usporedivih nekretnina
pribavljanje i uvid u isprave kojima se dokazuje vlasništvo ili drugo pravo raspolaganja nekretninom
provjeravanje stanja nekretnine u opsegu zakonskih obveza i dužne pažnje
osnovnu pripremu, fotografiranje, objavu oglasa i predstavljanje nekretnine na primjeren način
zaprimanje i osnovnu selekciju upita zainteresiranih osoba
organizaciju i vođenje razgledavanja te evidentiranje razgleda potvrdom o razgledavanju
povezivanje Nalogodavca i zainteresirane osobe te komunikaciju i pregovore u interesu Nalogodavca, prema njegovim uputama
administrativnu i organizacijsku koordinaciju pripremnih radnji za sklapanje ugovora o najmu, bez pružanja pravnih savjeta i sastavljanja pravnih isprava
Navedeni poslovi uključeni su u posredničku naknadu i ne naplaćuju se zasebno.
3. GRANICE USLUGE I DODATNA USLUGA PRIMOPREDAJE

Provjeravanje stanja nekretnine ne znači građevinsko-tehnički ili funkcionalni pregled, stručno mjerenje ili vještačenje. Posrednik ne sastavlja predugovore, ugovore o najmu, punomoći ni druge pravne isprave, nego administrativno i organizacijski koordinira komunikaciju, usuglašene podatke i termine povezane s njihovim sklapanjem.

Koordinacija primopredaje i administrativna priprema primopredajnog zapisnika prema podacima koje najmodavac i najmoprimac utvrde pri primopredaji dodatna je povezana usluga koja je standardno ugovorena svakim ugovorom o posredovanju MET d.o.o. za dugoročni najam stana. Pruža se za najam sklopljen kao rezultat posredovanja. Bez zasebne naknade - uključena je u ugovorenu posredničku naknadu. Najmodavac i najmoprimac sami provjeravaju podatke i potpisuju zapisnik.
4. NAKNADA, PLAĆANJE I TREĆE OSOBE

Posrednik stječe pravo na posredničku naknadu tek nakon sklapanja ugovora o najmu za koji je posredovao. Ne zahtijeva djelomično ni potpuno plaćanje unaprijed. Posredničku naknadu plaća isključivo Nalogodavac - najmodavac, bezgotovinski prema izdanom računu.
Najmoprimac ne plaća posredničku naknadu. MET d.o.o. ne naplaćuje posredničku naknadu ni drugim trećim osobama.

MET d.o.o. prema ovom Cjeniku nema drugih dodatnih povezanih usluga koje naplaćuje Nalogodavcu. Usluge trećih osoba, poput javnog bilježnika, odvjetnika, sudskog tumača ili energetskog certifikatora, nisu usluge MET d.o.o. i naručitelj ih plaća izravno toj osobi.
5. CJENIK POSREDNIČKIH I DODATNIH USLUGA
Osnovica za postotnu naknadu jest mjesečna najamnina ugovorena u sklopljenom ugovoru o najmu.

6. ZAVRŠNE ODREDBE

Na pitanja koja nisu uređena ovim dokumentom primjenjuju se Zakon o posredovanju u prometu nekretnina, Zakon o obveznim odnosima, Zakon o zaštiti potrošača i drugi primjenjivi propisi Republike Hrvatske. Ovi Opći uvjeti poslovanja i Cjenik dostupni su u poslovnim prostorijama i na mrežnoj stranici MET d.o.o.
GENERAL TERMS OF BUSINESS AND PRICE LIST OF MET d.o.o.

Savska cesta 32
10000 Zagreb, Croatia
OIB: 47926577116
Register of Real Estate Brokers: 30/2024
Date of adoption and commencement of application: 2 September 2026
1. APPLICATION

These General Terms of Business and Price List apply to brokerage services provided by MET d.o.o. in connection with long-term apartment rentals in Zagreb and the Zagreb metropolitan area, and form an integral part of every brokerage agreement concluded by MET d.o.o. with the Client.
2. SERVICES COVERED BY THE BROKERAGE FEE
Within the usual scope of open and exclusive brokerage, the fee covers:
informing the Client of the average market rent for comparable properties
obtaining and inspecting documents proving ownership or another right to dispose of the property
checking the condition of the property within the scope of statutory obligations and due care
basic preparation, photography, publication of the listing and appropriate presentation of the property
receiving and initially screening inquiries from interested persons
organizing and conducting viewings and recording them by means of a viewing confirmation
connecting the Client with the interested person and conducting communication and negotiations in the Client's interest and in accordance with the Client's instructions
administrative and organizational coordination of preparatory steps for concluding the rental agreement, without providing legal advice or drafting legal documents
The listed services are included in the brokerage fee and are not charged separately.
3. SCOPE OF SERVICE AND ADDITIONAL HANDOVER SERVICE

Checking the condition of the property does not constitute a structural, technical or functional inspection, professional measurement or expert assessment. The Broker does not draft preliminary agreements, rental agreements, powers of attorney or other legal documents, but administratively and organizationally coordinates the communication, agreed information and dates related to their conclusion.

Coordination of the property handover and administrative preparation of the handover record based on information established by the landlord and tenant during handover is an additional related service included as standard in every MET d.o.o. brokerage agreement for long-term apartment rental. It is provided for a rental concluded as a result of brokerage. No separate fee applies - it is included in the agreed brokerage fee. The landlord and tenant verify the information themselves and sign the record.
4. FEE, PAYMENT AND THIRD PARTIES

The Broker becomes entitled to the brokerage fee only after the rental agreement for which it provided brokerage services has been concluded. It does not require partial or full payment in advance. The brokerage fee is paid exclusively by the Client - the landlord, by cashless payment against an issued invoice.
The tenant does not pay a brokerage fee. MET d.o.o. does not charge a brokerage fee to any other third party.

Under this Price List, MET d.o.o. has no other additional related services that it charges to the Client. Services provided by third parties, such as a notary public, lawyer, court interpreter or energy certifier, are not services of MET d.o.o.; the Client engages and pays such persons directly.
5. PRICE LIST OF BROKERAGE AND ADDITIONAL SERVICES
The basis for the percentage fee is the monthly rent agreed in the concluded rental agreement.

100% of the agreed monthly rent; maximum 100%

children.text: On the date this Price List was adopted, MET d.o.o. was not registered for VAT; therefore, VAT is not charged on the stated amounts. This Price List applies from 2 September 2026.
6. FINAL PROVISIONS

Any matters not regulated by this document are governed by the Croatian Real Estate Brokerage Act, Obligations Act, Consumer Protection Act and other applicable regulations of the Republic of Croatia. These General Terms of Business and Price List are available at the business premises and on the website of MET d.o.o.
